# Dealer Agent Protocol
> Open MCP standard for car dealership inventory, availability, and pricing disclosure, so AI agents answer shoppers with the dealer's real price, real fees, and current availability. Apache-2.0. Reference gateway and synthetic test data available.

# DealershipMCP
> Dealer Growth Hackers product and hosted implementation of Dealer Agent Protocol. It provides an AI Answer Audit, static publication, a managed Dealer Agent Gateway, freshness monitoring, conformance claim hosting, and optional consented ADF handoff.

## Important distinctions
- Dealer Agent Protocol is the independently implementable open standard.
- A Dealer Agent Gateway is software that implements the standard.
- DealershipMCP is one commercial gateway product.
- Dealer Agent Protocol is not Auto Agent Protocol; a compatibility bridge is documented.
- Planned integrations are roadmap items, not partnership or availability claims.
